settings.text:
Total Light Block at the Top

  • Cozyology‘s refined system: Fully enclosed headrail + built-in brush strip + full-edge coverage = 100% blackout
  • Basic shades: Exposed gaps = unwanted top light leaks

Cleaner, Low-Maintenance Design

  • Cozyology‘s refined system: Roller stays fully sealed — no dust, no hassle
  • Basic shades: Open rollers collect dust and need constant upkeep

Built-In, Seamless Look

  • Cozyology‘s refined system: Square valance, color-matched and flush with your frame for a custom finish
  • Basic shades: Often look bulky, mismatched, or tacked-on

1-Channel Remote

  • Control: One shade per remote, operated independently
  • Best For: Single-shade setups or separate rooms
  • Efficiency: Simple, reliable, and easy to manage

16-Channel Remote

  • Control: Up to 16 shades individually (Channels 1–16); Channel CC controls all at once
  • Best For: Multi-shade spaces that need tailored control
  • Setup: Each channel is pre-programmed based on your order for seamless operation

For safe international shipping, the remote will arrive without a battery. A CR2032 or CR2450 battery can be purchased separately, and they’re easy to find at most general or hardware stores.
